camel_example: aliyun ossutil api put-bucket-cors --bucket examplebucket --region cn-hangzhou
description_en: Configures cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) rules for a specified bucket
description_zh: 设置指定存储空间（Bucket）的跨域资源共享CORS（Cross-Origin Resource Sharing）规则
name: PutBucketCors

parameters.description_en: The container for CORS rules of a bucket.

fields.description_en:
The container for CORS rules.

A maximum of 10 CORS rules can be configured for each bucket. The uploaded XML document can be up to 16 KB in size.
fields.description_zh:
CORS规则的容器。

每个Bucket最多允许10条CORS规则。上传的XML文档最大允许16 KB。
fields.help_en:
The container for CORS rules.

fields.help_zh:

fields.name: cors_rule

fields.description_en:
Specifies whether to return the Vary: Origin header. Valid values:

- true: The Vary: Origin header is returned regardless of whether the request is a cross-origin request or whether the cross-origin request succeeds.
- false (default): The Vary: Origin header is not returned in any case.

> This field cannot be configured independently. At least one cross-origin rule must be configured for this field to take effect.
fields.description_zh:
是否返回Vary: Origin头。取值范围如下：

- true：不管发送的是否是跨域请求或跨域请求是否成功，均会返回Vary: Origin头。
- false（默认值）：任何情况下均不返回Vary: Origin头。

> 此字段不能单独配置，必须至少配置一项跨域规则才能生效。
